title: NBA Algorithm Diagnosis
description: Why the current Elo selects home teams and which research model is strongest.

source.grain: one row per evaluated model on the untouched 2025-26 test season

accuracy.label: Accuracy
accuracy.definition: Correct winner selections divided by evaluated games.

brierScore.label: Brier score
brierScore.definition: Mean squared error of predicted home-win probability; lower is better.

logLoss.label: Log loss
logLoss.definition: Mean binary cross-entropy of predicted home-win probability; lower is better.

homePickPct.label: Home pick rate
homePickPct.definition: Share of games whose predicted home-win probability is at least 0.5.

evidenceFlow.detail: Compute accuracy, Brier score, log loss, AUC, ten-bin expected calibration error, and selection distribution on identical games.
